_comment: Copy to ~/.config/fhub/fhubd.json. Durations are Go strings ("10s"). Env values may use $VAR; command, cwd and log paths accept ~/. TODO: set machineId to the id the hub uses for the mini (defaults to the short hostname).

services._comment: TODO: (1) confirm the t3 launcher path on the mini (the Linux installer puts a shim in ~/.local/bin that execs ~/.t3/runtime/versions/<v>/t3). (2) T3 installs its own boot service ('t3 __service-launcher' as a LaunchAgent); disable it on the mini or two backends will fight over the same state, and the launchd one has no Full Disk Access. (3) T3CODE_HOME shared with the desktop app means both read the same state; decide whether headless replaces the desktop backend or gets its own --base-dir. (4) host 127.0.0.1 keeps T3 local; use the Tailscale IP or --tailscale-serve to reach it from other devices. Port 3790 avoids the desktop app's 3773.
services.name: t3
